title: Cloud Tenant Provisioning
scenario: An organization is preparing a Microsoft 365 tenant environment to support identity, collaboration, and device management services. Review the tenant setup workflow and complete the activities required to validate administrative readiness.

activities.title: Tenant Provisioning Workflow
activities.prompt: Arrange the following steps in the correct order to complete the initial tenant provisioning workflow.
steps: Create the tenant and organization profile
Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center
answer: Create the tenant and organization profile
Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center
activities.explanation: Tenant creation must be completed before administrative access and validation tasks can be performed.

activities.title: Portal Identification
activities.prompt: Match each administrative portal to its primary purpose.
activities.explanation: Each portal has a different administrative scope and should be validated for the correct purpose.

activities.title: Subscription Verification
activities.prompt: Select the portal used to verify that the Microsoft 365 Business Premium subscription is active.
activities.explanation: Subscription and billing information is reviewed in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

activities.title: Tenant Information
activities.prompt: Select the page that displays tenant identity details such as the tenant ID and primary domain.
activities.explanation: The overview page provides tenant-level identity information.

activities.title: Branding Workflow Validation
activities.prompt: Select the stages that are part of the company branding workflow.
activities.explanation: Branding configuration includes the visual and sign-in customization stages, not infrastructure tasks such as DHCP scope creation.

activities.title: Branding Validation Method
activities.prompt: Select the best method used to validate whether branding changes have propagated successfully.
options: Open a private browser window and test the sign-in experience
Create a new Azure virtual machine
activities.answer: Open a private browser window and test the sign-in experience
activities.explanation: A private browser window helps validate the live sign-in experience without relying on cached session data.
